verdict.rationale: Plaid has a dedicated Identity Verification API reference that documents a /identity_verification/retry endpoint. STATUS_UPDATED and STEP_UPDATED webhooks provide programmatic lifecycle signals. However, the evidence shows session start through Link client-side flows, and status viewing and failure overrides through the Dashboard, not API calls. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints to create a session, get its status, retrieve results and captured media, and cancel or redact a session, plus any hands-on corroboration.
